Title: Ligand-based prediction of hERG blockade
Description: Predicts blockade of the hERG potassium channel, the cardiac liability most often responsible for late-stage attrition. CardioTox net combines several molecular representations into a meta-feature ensemble rather than relying on one descriptor family, an arrangement Karim and colleagues found more robust across external test sets than any single model. They placed particular emphasis on performance for compounds dissimilar to the training data, which is where hERG predictors typically degrade.
Interpretation: Probability that a compound blocks the hERG potassium channel.
